playoff.entries: 1-2 straight to the semi-finals, 3-6 into quarter-finals
playoff.note: Apertura and Clausura each crown a champion; the aggregate table across both decides relegation.

playoff.entries: group leaders into the knockout, then a final
playoff.note: Champion goes up; the runner-up plays the 9th-placed Liga Primera club for a second place.

boundaries.note: Liga Primera relegation comes from the aggregate table over Apertura + Clausura: last goes down, 9th plays the Ascenso runner-up over two legs. Ascenso champion goes up directly. Two places, one contested.

conflicts.note: The competition's official name is Segunda División de Nicaragua; the league and Transfermarkt both brand it 'Liga de Ascenso'. Our name is the branded one, and our id NC2A matches that branding.

notes: Nicaragua runs two tournaments per season (Apertura in the second half of the calendar year, Clausura in the first half of the next). Liga Primera: 10 clubs, each tournament is a double round robin of 18 rounds, then a six-club knockout (top two to the semis, 3rd-6th to a quarter-final). Relegation is decided on the aggregate table across both tournaments, not on a single tournament - hence selection 'average_table'. Ascenso: 12 clubs in two groups of six (Centro and Costa), 10 rounds, group leaders into a knockout; the champion is promoted and the runner-up meets the Liga Primera 9th. In 2026 Real Madriz went down as last and San Marcos came up as champions, while UNAN Managua beat Matiguás in the play-off.
